purpose: Test whether version-corrected CoordRep fields provide task-dependent predictive information beyond a matched 2D GINE and whether the corrected shape/CShM block contributes within the hybrid.

cohort_and_splits.outer_folds: unchanged coordstate_pairs_manifest_v1 record folds grouped by frozen canonical attributed graph
cohort_and_splits.inner_validation: unchanged GroupShuffleSplit over outer-training graph groups

input_gate.coordrep_fields: full 48,057-record v1.1.2 candidate output generated with validated coordinate-space CShM

models.name: gine_wide
models.source: reuse the already frozen OOF predictions only after exact record/fold/seed/target/truth key audit; rerun only if the audit fails

models.name: hybrid_corrected
models.role: same graph trunk plus all corrected CoordRep fields
models.training: same archived runner, hyperparameters, folds, seeds, and stopping policy; no retuning

models.name: hybrid_corrected_shape_masked
models.mask_policy: zero the train-fitted columns, including missingness companions, while preserving input dimension, initialization policy, architecture, optimizer, folds, and seeds

primary_estimands.interpretation: positive values favor the corrected CoordRep side channel
positive values indicate an incremental contribution from the corrected shape/CShM block conditional on the other CoordRep fields

estimation.prediction_unit: each record receives one OOF prediction per seed
estimation.seed_policy: average predictions across the three seeds before calculating recordwise absolute error
estimation.multiple_testing: report both targets and both contrasts with confidence intervals; do not select only favorable cells

exclusions.archived_shape_defined_pairs: excluded because their membership was generated by the invalid frozen shape implementation
exclusions.new_pair_analysis: requires a separately frozen corrected pair manifest and is not a prerequisite for the record-level benchmark

claim_boundary: This is a task- and implementation-conditional predictive comparison, not proof that CoordRep universally outperforms GNNs.
The shape-masked contrast attributes performance to the corrected shape-field block only within this hybrid architecture and cohort.
A null or adverse result is reported as a NO-GO and cannot be replaced by an archived frozen-shape result.
SchNet receives full Cartesian coordinates and remains a common-cohort, unequal-information comparator rather than an architecture-matched ablation.
